The '''Kafrene asteroid belt''' was an [[Asteroid field|asteroid belt]]<ref name="Rogue One novelization" /> located in the [[Thand sector]]<ref name="RO World Locations" /> of [[the galaxy]]'s [[Expansion Region]]<ref name="The Ultimate Visual Guide" /> that contained the [[Ring of Kafrene]].<ref name="Rogue One novelization" />
